name: LeadFollowUpCardList
tagline: The Lead Follow-up Card List turns any list of leads into a "who do I call next" work list.
description: The Lead Follow-up Card List turns any list of leads into a "who do I call next" work list. Each lead is a card with the contact, company, status, a Hot / Warm / Cold score badge, when the next follow-up is due and how long ago the lead was last contacted. Leads that have not been touched for too long get a Going cold warning, and every card has one-tap Call, Email, Log follow-up and Open buttons.
features: Hot / warm / cold scoring, going-cold warnings, search
Grouping and quick call / email / log follow-up actions raised to Power Fx
